card.title: How To Fix iPhone 7 With Grayed Out Speaker Icon, Audio IC Repair

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 7 With Grayed Out Speaker Icon, Audio IC Repair

symptoms: speaker icon greyed out in calls
7-minute Apple logo boot on older iOS

claims.statement: iPhone 7 'audio disease' is caused by pads C12 (and sometimes D12) breaking under audio IC U3101; the chip itself is usually fine and can be reballed and reused.
Fix: reball U3101 and add jumpers—C12 to the trace toward R1103, D12 to G12; optionally F12→C3220, H12→R3103, J12→R3104.
Quick tests: speaker button greyed out in a call, or voice memo failing to record (or distorting while gently twisting the frame). Bluetooth audio still works.
Excess heat during this repair can cause baseband no-service faults; replace (don't reball) an underfilled audio IC.

procedure: Make a test call and check the speaker button; test Voice Memos.
Add C12 and D12 jumpers (plus others if pads ripped); UV-mask.
Reball and refit U3101 (replace if underfilled or damaged).
Test voice memo playback on both speakers and a call.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Overheating during audio IC work can float the baseband CPU.
